project.title: 宴會
project.music: 低沉的弦樂鋪底，打臉的那一刻重拍落下，之後抽空

style_lock.zh: 寫實攝影，數位電影機質感，清晰銳利，中等飽和，輕微顆粒
style_lock.en: photorealistic, digital cinema camera look, crisp detail, moderate saturation, subtle grain

negative_global.zh: 多餘的手指，變形的手，浮水印，磨皮過度的皮膚
negative_global.en: extra fingers, deformed hands, watermark, airbrushed skin

negative_video.zh: 閃爍，畫面抖動，臉部變形，人物變臉，肢體扭曲，多出來的人
negative_video.en: flicker, camera shake, warped faces, face changing between frames, twisted limbs, extra people

tag.zh: 黑色及肩直髮的高瘦女子
tag.en: the tall slim woman with straight shoulder-length black hair

look.zh: 二十八歲左右的女性，鵝蛋臉，黑色及肩直髮別在耳後，眉形平直，眼睛細長，身形高瘦
look.en: a woman of about twenty-eight, oval face, straight shoulder-length black hair tucked behind her ears, level brows, long narrow eyes, tall slim build

marks.en: a small mole at the tail of her left eyebrow

detail.zh: 皮膚白而略乾，看得到細小的毛孔，眼角有很淡的細紋，指甲修短沒有塗色
detail.en: pale, slightly dry skin with visible fine pores, faint lines at the corners of her eyes, short unpainted nails

voice.zh: 二十多歲的女聲，音色偏低，說話慢而穩
voice.en: a low, steady female voice in her late twenties

outfit.zh: 白色羊毛西裝外套與同色西裝褲，裡面是黑色絲質上衣，黑色尖頭低跟鞋
outfit.en: a white wool suit jacket and matching trousers over a black silk top, black pointed low heels

outfit_top.zh: 白色羊毛西裝外套，裡面是黑色絲質上衣
outfit_top.en: a white wool suit jacket over a black silk top

detail.zh: 西裝的肩線俐落，翻領的布料有細緻的斜紋，袖口露出一點黑色絲質袖口
detail.en: sharp shoulder line, fine twill weave on the lapels, a sliver of black silk cuff showing at the sleeves

outfit.zh: 白色羊毛西裝外套與同色西裝褲，裡面是黑色絲質上衣，黑色尖頭低跟鞋
outfit.en: a white wool suit jacket and matching trousers over a black silk top, black pointed low heels

outfit_top.zh: 白色羊毛西裝外套，裡面是黑色絲質上衣
outfit_top.en: a white wool suit jacket over a black silk top

state.zh: 白色羊毛西裝外套的翻領到前襟一片顏色變深的濕痕，帶著淡淡的金黃色，布料表面掛著幾顆酒珠
state.en: a darkened wet patch with a faint golden tinge running from the lapels down the front of the white wool jacket, beads of champagne clinging to the fabric

expressions.zh: 平靜、眼神不閃躲的冷淡、嘴角微微上揚的不露聲色、眉頭微皺的審視
expressions.en: calm, a cool unflinching gaze, a barely lifted corner of the mouth, a slight frown of appraisal

tag.zh: 栗色大波浪長髮的年輕女子
tag.en: the young woman with long chestnut waves

look.zh: 二十五歲左右的女性，尖下巴，栗色大波浪長髮披在背後，濃眉，眼尾上挑，身形纖細
look.en: a woman of about twenty-five, pointed chin, long chestnut waves falling down her back, thick brows, upswept eyes, slender build

stature.zh: 身高約一百六十二公分

marks.en: a pair of large pearl earrings

detail.zh: 妝很完整，粉底略厚，正紅色的唇膏，睫毛刷得很長
detail.en: full makeup with slightly heavy foundation, true-red lipstick, long mascaraed lashes

voice.zh: 二十出頭的女聲，音調偏高，說話快，尾音上揚
voice.en: a high, quick female voice in her early twenties that lilts up at the end

outfit.zh: 香檳色緞面露肩長禮服，銀色細帶高跟鞋
outfit.en: a champagne satin off-the-shoulder evening gown, thin-strapped silver heels

detail.zh: 緞面在光下有柔和的反光，裙擺垂墜，腰線收得很緊
detail.en: the satin catching soft highlights, a fluid draped skirt, a tightly fitted waist

expressions.zh: 一邊嘴角上揚的冷笑、咬著下唇的狠勁、下巴揚起的得意、笑容僵住嘴唇微張
expressions.en: a one-sided sneer, biting her lower lip in spite, chin raised in triumph, a frozen smile with lips parted

tag.zh: 戴細框眼鏡的灰髮中年男子
tag.en: the grey-haired middle-aged man in thin-framed glasses

look.zh: 五十歲左右的男性，國字臉，灰白短髮梳得整齊，細框眼鏡，身形微胖
look.en: a man of about fifty, square face, neatly combed short grey hair, thin-framed glasses, slightly heavy build

stature.zh: 身高約一百七十五公分

voice.zh: 五十多歲的男聲，沉穩，語速慢
voice.en: a calm, unhurried male voice in his fifties

outfit.zh: 深灰色三件式西裝，白襯衫，深藍色領帶，黑色皮鞋
outfit.en: a dark grey three-piece suit, white shirt, navy tie, black leather shoes

outfit_top.zh: 深灰色西裝外套與背心，白襯衫，深藍色領帶
outfit_top.en: a dark grey suit jacket and waistcoat, white shirt, navy tie

detail.zh: 西裝布料是細密的毛料，背心的鈕扣是深色牛角扣，領帶打得很端正，皮鞋擦得發亮
detail.en: fine worsted suiting, dark horn buttons on the waistcoat, a precisely knotted tie, shoes polished to a shine

space.zh: 五星級酒店宴會廳的入口，兩扇高大的雙開木門敞開，門外是鋪著深紅地毯的走廊，門內是挑高的宴會廳，天花板垂著水晶吊燈，門內靠牆有一張鋪白布的簽到台
space.en: the entrance of a five-star hotel banquet hall, tall double wooden doors standing open onto a corridor with deep red carpet, a high-ceilinged hall inside with crystal chandeliers, a sign-in table draped in white cloth against the wall just inside the doors

light.zh: 水晶吊燈的暖黃光從上方柔和地灑下，門外的走廊較暗
light.en: warm yellow light falling softly from the crystal chandeliers above, the corridor outside the doors dimmer

palette.zh: 暗部偏深棕，點綴色是地毯的深紅
palette.en: shadows leaning deep brown, the deep red of the carpet as the accent

ambient.zh: 背景的賓客有細微的動作，換一下重心、手裡的酒杯輕輕晃動，水晶吊燈的光在杯子上微微閃動
ambient.en: the guests in the background shift their weight and their glasses sway slightly, the chandelier light glints softly on the glasses

detail.zh: 木門有深色的拼花與黃銅把手，地毯的絨毛被踩得有點倒伏，牆上是淺金色的絲質壁布
detail.en: dark parquet inlay and brass handles on the doors, carpet pile slightly flattened by footsteps, pale gold silk wallcovering

desc.zh: 一只盛著半杯香檳的細長高腳杯
desc.en: a tall flute half full of champagne

空.zh: 一只空了的細長高腳杯

detail.zh: 薄透的玻璃杯身，杯腳細長，杯緣有一圈淡淡的口紅印
detail.en: thin clear glass, a long slender stem, a faint ring of lipstick on the rim

pending: 形式與媒材：依「宴會」「打臉」的題材暫定真人寫實的豎屏短劇
工具未定：提示詞是不限工具的完整版，通用負面詞先寫好；選定工具後照工具的長度、秒數與弱點改一次
C02 許曼與 C03 周經理的外貌、服裝：原文沒寫，暫定栗色大波浪長髮配香檳色禮服、灰髮細框眼鏡配深灰西裝
三個角色的聲線：原文沒寫，暫定如設定表
